title: Say Sipan na Ag-Niyanak
intro: Say masimoon a kamarerwa so nanggawa na sagradon sipan sakbay na insabi na sakey ya ugaw. Say istorya na sayan pigura et nagagawa ed loob na saray padir na sakey a santuaryo, a ditan et say debosyon et naawat na Dios. Siopa yan lingkor nen Allah?
clues: Kabiangan ak na pamilyan papagalangan na Quran.
Nansamba ak ya idedika so agni nianak ya anak ko ed serbisyo ed si Allah.
Nen nananak ak, abigla ak ta sakey itan ya anak a bii, anggaman inilaloan kon anak a laki.
Inngaran koy anak ko ya Maryam, sakey a ngaran ya mangipapatnag na debosyon tan serbisyo.
Kinerew ko so proteksion nen Allah parad anak ko tan saray kabyangay boleg to manlapud sinumpa a Satanas.
Say anak ko et inawat na Katawan tan inyan tod silong na panangasikaso nen Propeta Zakariya diad santuaryo.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say asawa nen Imran (Ina nen Maryam)
Asiya ya asawa nen Faraon
Maryam, ina nen Isa
Say ina nen Propeta Musa
Say Reyna na Sheba
identity.answer: Say asawa nen Imran (Ina nen Maryam)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Mansipan ya idedika toy anak to ed templo
Say pangibantak ed apoy
Say ibaliw ed dayat diad amagan dalin
Manggagawa na baleg a biong
Say inakmon na baleg a sira
trial.answer: Mansipan ya idedika toy anak to ed templo

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say santuaryo (mihrab) ya angiyan ed anak to
Say kaban na sipanan
Say balitok a baka
Say baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Say date palm ya inpapainawaan to
location.answer: Say santuaryo (mihrab) ya angiyan ed anak to

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Inawat so anak to tan inyan ed silong na panangasikaso nen Propeta Zakariya
Sikatoy niliktar ed dusa na sakey a managpairap
Sikatoy inikdan na sakey ya anak a laki a manngaran na Yahya
Saray totoo to et aderal lapud bagyo
Nagmaliw ya reyna ed baleg a panarian
outcome.answer: Inawat so anak to tan inyan ed silong na panangasikaso nen Propeta Zakariya

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
